about_the_game:
Overview

Hi there, everyone, do you like horror games?

I think a lot of people aren't into them.

They have that creepy atmosphere and sudden scares.

But the stories are often intriguing. Even if you're curious enough to want to play, the fear usually wins out, and you end up not being able to.

That happens, right?

This game is designed with "maximum" consideration for people who are not good at horror games.

Various designs have been used to make the scary elements of horror games less frightening.

However, since it is a horror game, there may be some elements that are a little scary.

We aimed to create a game that is “seems scary but isn't, but still a little scary...”

This game is especially recommended for people who are not good at horror games.

I’m sure that after completing it, you’ll feel like you’ve truly conquered a horror game.

This trial version lets you enjoy the first 10 to 20 minutes of the game.

Story

In search of his childhood friend Hiroi, who wandered into a deserted factory with a dark history while chasing his pet cat, the protagonist Kino arrives at the factory.

There, strange things happen... well, not many, but a few...

Will Kino be able to rescue Hiroi and return home safely?

Age restriction

There is a small amount of blood.

Horror elements have been minimized with the maximum consideration.
